verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes its own rendered OpenAPI 3.0 reference at api.secureframe.com/docs. It covers resource-oriented endpoint groups with request/response schemas and embeds the full machine-readable spec, so a browsable API reference clearly exists. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as a try-it console or executable code samples. missing for 10: documented try-it/runnable request console, code samples per endpoint, a separately downloadable spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
